plan.sub: Lessons for the units of {course} ({publisher}) and topic lessons
plan.intro: The lessons run along two parallel tracks. Unit lessons reinforce what you covered in class: after a class, open the lesson with the same number. It goes deeper into the unit’s grammar, with the exceptions and with comparisons to English, and has exercises and a mission — a small real-life task in Catalan. Topic and overview lessons are added on request, when you want to dig into a topic or see the big picture.
plan.note: The grammar topics of the units are reconstructed from their titles and the usual Bàsic syllabus. Once they are checked against the textbook’s contents, the plan will be corrected.

sync.title: Sync between devices
sync.sub: One progress on your phone and laptop — no sign-up
sync.intro: Your progress is stored in the browser. To see it on all your devices, turn on sync — no sign-up, just a code or a QR code:
sync.step1: On this device, tap “Turn on sync” — a code and a QR code appear.
sync.step2: On another device, scan the QR code with the camera, or type the code and tap “Connect”.
sync.step3: After studying, tap “Sync now” so your progress shows up on your other devices.
sync.badCode: This code doesn’t look right: check the characters
sync.joinText: The progress of this device will be merged with the progress of the other devices that use this code.
sync.switchText: This device already syncs with a different code. Switch to this one? The progress will be merged.
sync.scan: Scan the QR code with your phone’s camera — the site opens, and you only need to tap “Connect”.
sync.qrLabel: QR code with the link to connect
sync.keepSecret: The code is the key to your progress: don’t share it publicly.
sync.forget: Delete the data from the server
sync.forgetNote: Each device keeps its progress. Turning sync off on a device does not touch the data on the server.
sync.privacy: Your progress is encrypted on the device with a key derived from the code. The server stores only encrypted data and knows neither the code nor your progress.
sync.framed: This page is open inside another website. To set up sync, open Quadern de català in its own tab.
sync.errorOffline: No connection to the sync server — try again later
sync.errorServer: The sync server is unavailable — try again later
sync.errorData: Could not read the sync data: check the code
sync.manualNote: Sync runs when you tap “Sync now”: tap it on the device where you studied, then on the one where you want to continue.
